description: Figure 6 (left) is a pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation,” which illustrates the proportional contribution of different datasets to the AttrEval-Simulation set. The chart is divided into five colored segments, each labeled with a dataset name and its corresponding percentage: ENTITYQUEST (blue, 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, 24.2%), POPQA (yellow, 21.6%), TRIVIAQA (orange, 22.7%), and WEBQUESTIO (teal, 3.6%). A small green segment labeled TREC (1.9%) is also present. Each segment is connected to its label via a thin line, and the percentages are displayed next to the labels. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of ENTITYQUEST and HOTPOTQA, which together account for over half of the data, while TREC and WEBQUESTIO contribute minimally. The overall layout is clean, with distinct colors and clear labeling for each data source.
